items: Full printed certificate and summary URLs; old unique certificate prefixes resolve safely.
Plain scoring explanation before the first attempt and in How it works.
Consistent readership pool, top-decile, outside-pool and standard-score wording.
Reserved by the house wording and configured house-count explanation.
All-claimant ranks distinguished from finished-player comparisons.
One-sentence game description directly above the large launch countdown.
Dated edition labels on archived captions and link-preview images.
Invitation on both share images, prominent category/result, owner answers by default and remembered Hide my answers.
One in-flow phone Share button with More; desktop retains its two-by-two actions.
Android image+caption when supported; Apple image-only with caption copied, preserving native user activation.
limitations: Browser engines and device profiles are emulated, not physical phones. Native-share payloads and activation are tested with API stubs.
Local Firefox could not start with its profile; required Firefox tests run on Linux CI.
Production has zero prelaunch claims; no fabricated records will be created to test a live certificate. Actual printed URLs are tested in practice and the production-mode handler is tested locally.

loadTest.reason: Not run before the permitted 7:05 PM ET window. R12 section 5 explicitly allows skipping instead of waiting for that window.
